newsitem.title: INDIA: India Reliance up 3.0 pct before results.
newsitem.headline: India Reliance up 3.0 pct before results.

text.p: Shares of India's largest private firm Reliance Industries jumped 8.0 rupees, or 3.0 percent to 276 on the Bombay bourse on Thursday as speculators bid ahead of the company's results, traders said.
Results for the financial year ended March 31, 1997 are due on April 22.
Traders said speculators were also taking positions in the stock ahead of it entering a no-delivery period on the Bombay and National bourses next week.
A no-delivery period allows speculators to trade in the stock without taking delivery for around one month.
